source: OpenStreetMap / OpenSeaMap via QLever OSM planet
freshnessPolicy: Refresh at least every 30 days and before a production release.
limitations: Community-maintained POIs can be incomplete or stale.
QLever's OSM planet snapshot may lag live OpenStreetMap edits.
A mapped fuel point does not guarantee current stock, opening hours, berth access, or fuel compatibility.
POIs are planning references and do not affect the navigability mask.
